text:
جنج پرائی احمق نچّن۔
مجھوں ننگے ویلا گھتّن۔
romanized:
Janj parāī ahmak nachchin.
Majjhū nange vélā ghattin.
literal_en:
Only fools dance at another's wedding
and people naked at the waist throw money to the dancers.
meaning_en: i.e., extremely poor. (Said of a man interfering in matters with which he has no concern.)

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
